Anthropic 生物学研究团队分享与 Claude 合作完成细菌来源 vault 粒子首个 3D 结构测定的过程。Vault 粒子是 1986 年发现的大型桶状蛋白结构，功能至今未知；此前只见于动物和植物等复杂生命，团队证明细菌及其病毒中的类似蛋白也能组装成 vault。Claude 在部分环节大幅提速，人工测定结构需数周到数月，该项目只用数天，但也出现一些简单错误，团队与机器学习研究者协作修正。作者补充称 Claude 实际运行了湿实验室流程，将粒子分离从 3 天缩短到约 90 分钟，34 小时内给出首个 3D 结构模型。

Vibe coding 指用随性描述让 AI 写代码、少做深审；批评者担心细节被忽略，长期反而拖累质量与生产力。

英文原标题：Developers Debate Vibe Coding's Productivity Trap（中文为 AI 翻译，仅供参考）

One engineer nailed it: vibe coding lets you feel productive while nothing actually ships. It's sparking raw clashes over AI's role in real software work.

Vibe coding means prompting AI with casual descriptions to generate code, skipping deep reviews—a practice Andrej Karpathy popularized in 2025 by embracing the 'vibes' and ignoring the details. Critics, including a robotics student who lost passion for programming and a veteran architect spotting serious flaws, warn it builds bugs, debt, and an illusion of progress. Supporters see value in quick prototypes with later fixes, though studies show higher security risks; most pros still skip it for core work but use it for fast tasks.

Oumi 推出 Frontier AI Engineer（FAiE），可把简单任务描述变成带权重的专用模型，用户输入约 15 分钟、再训练数小时。

英文原标题：Oumi Launches FAiE to Automate Custom AI Agent Building（中文为 AI 翻译，仅供参考）

Imagine describing a task in plain words and getting a ready-to-use AI agent hours later. Oumi's new FAiE tool makes that real by handling the heavy engineering lift.

Oumi introduced FAiE, its Frontier AI Engineer, which turns simple task descriptions into specialized AI models complete with trained weights—often after just 15 minutes of user input and a few hours of automated work. The system automates evaluations, failure diagnosis, data curation, training strategies, and experiments, while extending to full agent development with tools, environments, and methods like supervised fine-tuning and direct preference optimization. Co-founder Manos Koukoumidis called out the irony of AI automating everything except AI engineering itself, positioning FAiE as a step toward owning task-optimized models instead of renting generic ones. Early feedback praises the speed—from months to minutes—and continuous improvement from production failures, though some seek more real-world benchmarks.
